app.py.name: Interactive book catalog
app.py.description: Normalizes dates, prices into integer cents and selected IDs; imports CSV titles with deduplication; offers add/list/ID lookup/edit/delete and oldest/newest/count analysis in terminal menus. Main creates tables, imports suggestions and enters the loop.

models.py.name: Book mapping and SQLite session
models.py.description: Creates SQLAlchemy engine/session and declarative Book fields for title, author, publication date and integer-cent price. No application import or database access was performed.

README.md.name: Course project overview
README.md.description: Describes the SQLAlchemy books exercise and provides running instructions; this map instead inspects source without running it.
